title: Dimension Spawn
description: Mod for changing the dimension to spawn in by config.
body:
This mod allow the player to spawn in all the 3 dimension when creating a world.

The dimension to spawn in is set to Overworld by default.

You can change the config file to set the dimension and the (X,Z) in the config folder or for NeoForge also in Mods Menu in-game.
